_siteUrl_help: Khaali chhodo: GitHub Actions apne aap https://<username>.github.io/<repo>/ laga dega. Apna domain lo to yahan likho, jaise https://techkadak.in
tagline: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.
description: Tech Kadak: free Android apps, free AI tools, open-source GitHub apps aur paid apps ke free alternatives — official download links, limits aur Hinglish explanation ke saath.

daily._mode_help: queue-then-ai = pehle queue.json, khatam ho to AI (agar GEMINI_API_KEY secret hai). ai-then-queue = pehle AI. queue-only = sirf queue.

ai._source_help: fdroid = F-Droid ke official index se app chunega; github = GitHub search se naye Android open-source repos.

ads._help: AdSense approve hone ke baad: enabled true karo aur adsenseClient mein apna ca-pub-XXXX likho. Tab tak kuch mat bharo.

_googleSiteVerification_help: Google Search Console ka HTML tag wala code (sirf content="..." ke andar wala hissa) yahan paste karo.
